## Expected storage effects

The simulation must show only the contracts allowlisted by
`OPCMConfigureStandardGamesV700`. The v7.1.17 initializers re-run, but their idempotent writes
produce no net state diff outside the DisputeGameFactory. In particular, verify:

1. all L1 proxy implementations remain on the v7.1.17 implementation bundle;
2. `gameImpls(0)`, `gameImpls(1)`, and `gameImpls(8)` are non-zero and their `gameArgs`
   match the two prestates, RECA chain ID, proposer, and Standard challenger above;
3. game types 4, 5, 9, and 10 remain disabled with zero initial bond;
4. all enabled initial bonds equal 0.08 ETH;
5. `respectedGameType()` remains 1; and
6. no existing dispute-game proxy is modified.

The pinned root simulation produces exactly the following net state changes. The
DisputeGameFactory uses mapping slots 101 (`gameImpls`), 102 (`initBonds`), and 105
(`gameArgs`). A 124-byte permissionless `gameArgs` blob has the layout
`prestate(32) | vm(20) | ASR(20) | delayedWETH(20) | chainId(32)`; its dynamic-bytes length
marker is `0xf9` (`124 * 2 + 1`).
